ohneb_afk_cinematics.number.invalid: Enter a number in the range shown in the field’s tooltip.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.automatic.help: Start after you stop using the controls. Any movement or gameplay input returns to your normal view.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.delay.help: Wait 10–600 seconds before starting an AFK cinematic. Type an exact number.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.useGameFov.help: Use your current Minecraft field of view, including its normal movement effects. Turn off to set a separate cinematic FOV.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.customFov.label: Field of view
ohneb_afk_cinematics.customFov.help: 30–140°. Higher values show more of the surroundings. Very wide views stretch the edges. Your Minecraft FOV stays unchanged.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.fps.help: 20–240 FPS during automatic AFK cinematics. Manual views keep your normal limit. VSync and hardware still apply.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.hideHud.help: Hide the HUD, crosshair and outlines, like F1. Your F1 setting stays unchanged.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.hidePlayerNames.hel: Hide player name tags and scoreboard labels during cinematics.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.letterbox.help: Add black bars above and below the view.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.music.help: Add music during cinematics, after any current track finishes. Toggle without leaving the view with /afkcinematics music.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.unfocused.help: Keep playing when you switch windows. Pausing the game still stops the camera.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.unavailable: The camera is unavailable right now. Close other menus and try again.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.no_view: No clear view nearby. Try another spot or enable more shot types.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.save_error: Could not save settings. Check the config folder permissions.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.read_error: Settings could not be read. The existing file has been preserved.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.motion.help: Normal camera travel, shorter moves, or a fixed angle. Manual views still follow you.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.subject: Subject
ohneb_afk_cinematics.subject.help: What automatic AFK cinematics show. Manual cinematics follow you and your current activity.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.playerShare.help: How often Mixed views show the player. 0% favors scenery; 100% favors the player. Blocked views still fall back to a clear alternative.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.transition.help: Cut switches shots instantly. Fade briefly passes through black. Neither changes camera speed or black-bar animation.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.pace.help: %s to %s seconds before the next cut. Shorter shots keep the same calm camera speed.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.arc.help: A slow arc around the subject.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.diagonal_glide: Travel forward and sideways through the view with a steady heading.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.rising_pass.he: Climb gently while flying forward through the scenery.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.descending_pas: Descend on a steady forward approach.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.pull_away.help: Fly backward while keeping the same heading to reveal a wider view.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.dolly.help: Move gently toward or away from the subject.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.crane.help: A gentle vertical move with a little sideways drift.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.overhead.help: Look down over scenery when the ceiling is clear. Not used for player shots.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.flyover.help: A level aerial drive across the view. Scenery keeps a steady heading rather than circling one point.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.low_pass.help: Track close to the ground or canopy, where the full path is clear.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.reveal.help: Pull back and rise in one continuous move to reveal the surroundings.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.pan.help: Hold position while slowly turning across the view.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shots.set.help: Choose a group to edit. Presets affect only this group. Manual views keep a fixed fallback if the whole group is off.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.fly_through.he: Travel forward through the scenery with a steady heading, over canopies, near the ground or underwater.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.traverse.help: A broad sideways drive that keeps its heading and lets the environment move through the frame.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shots.last: Enable another shot before turning this one off.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.trail.help: Follow a journey from an angled position behind the player.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.escort.help: Track a journey from the side, letting the landscape pass behind it.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.lead.help: Film a journey from an oblique position ahead of the player.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.wide_track.hel: Pull higher and farther out to show the journey and surrounding terrain.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.angler.help: A broad sideways view of the angler, line and surrounding bank.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.cast_line.help: Glide past the angler with the fishing line leading out into the water.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.float.help: Look back across the float toward the angler and shoreline, just above the water.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.low_escort.hel: Follow near the waterline or just below a flyer, with the landscape passing behind them.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.high_trail.hel: Follow from high behind the journey, leaving room for the landscape ahead.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.broadside.help: Track the journey in profile with space in front of the player.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.pass_by.help: A planted camera pans as you pass, then switches before you leave the frame.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shot.overlook.help: Watch the journey from a fixed, elevated viewpoint.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.bindings.help: Change the cinematic key in Minecraft’s key bindings. F6 starts or stops a manual view while you play.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.keepChat.help: Keep automatic cinematics running while typing. Manual views always allow chat.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.soundtrack.help: Game music, Creative tracks, a selection of music discs, or a sound from your resource packs. Use /afkcinematics music next to skip.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.musicVolume.help: Volume of tracks started by this mod. Your normal Music and Master volume settings still apply.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.customMusic.help: Enter a sound event from a loaded resource pack, such as minecraft:music.creative.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.customMusic.missing: Sound not found in your loaded resource packs.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.key.start: %s toggles the camera while you play.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.key.unbound: Set a Start / stop key in Controls.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.start.disabled: Cinematics are off. Turn them on in General settings.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.start.world: Join a world to start a cinematic.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.start.spectator: Cinematics are unavailable in spectator mode.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.start.unsafe: Wait until you are safe and awake to start a cinematic.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.wildlife.help: Brief views of nearby animals during AFK scenery shots. Rare, spaced apart, and never the same species twice in a row.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.autoSleep.help: Film your bed and surroundings while you sleep. Leave Bed and chat work normally. Sleep timing stays unchanged.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.autoFishing.help: Start once your bobber reaches water. Reel in normally to return; music carries over if you cast again soon.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.frontTravel.help: Allow cameras ahead of you while travelling. Turn off to keep rear and side views, including when the camera moves around an obstacle. AFK and fishing shots are unchanged.
ohneb_afk_cinematics.toggle.label: Start / stop key
ohneb_afk_cinematics.playerShare.label: Player shots
ohneb_afk_cinematics.musicVolume.label: Volume
ohneb_afk_cinematics.shots.front_off: Front travel shots are off in General. Your individual shot selection is kept.
